decision: Add DAAX_AGENT_IMAGE_OVERRIDE, an operator env var that wins over the client-supplied image for every new agent container (port of PR #486)
rationale: AI-tool sessions always send an image param (components/terminal/TerminalManager.tsx sets it from localStorage), so CLAUDE_CONTAINER_IMAGE, consulted only when none is sent, never moves a real session. The override is applied before pull/fallback resolution and only on docker run, never on docker exec. Read at call time and validated against VALID_IMAGE_NAME_PATTERN; an invalid value is ignored with a warning. Passed through both compose files, empty by default
alternatives: Port #486's module-load constant and tautological precedence test (rejected: untestable per case and the test did not exercise the handler); rely on feat/multi-tenant's locked containerImage tenant setting (not on main; applies only to ticketed sessions with a policy, not the local operator bypass, and is DB-scoped rather than a host-wide operator lever)
